remarks:
Location, Location!!!! Welcome to 595 Seneca Street, Unit #7! This hard-to-find 2-bedroom condo is perfectly situated in the heart of the Village of Lewiston. Offering approximately 1,080 square feet, this charming condo features 2 bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and a full basement providing plenty of additional storage space.
Enjoy the convenience of village living with shops, restaurants, local attractions, and Artpark, all just a short walk away. Whether you're looking for a low-maintenance home, a weekend getaway, or a place close to everything Lewiston has to offer, this location is hard to beat!
Opportunities like this don't come along often—don't miss your chance to make this adorable Lewiston condo your own!
